title: cli + objectql: record-currency backfill scoped per organization — `--org`, refuse multi-org runs without it, `--all-organizations` explicit; recompute takes the same `--org` (multi-currency, epic #8345, ruling C item A)
body:
epic:#8345#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZWjnSeed8H4dMjt9d

Part of #8345. Filed by the epic PM from ruling 6670707546 (letter C, maintainer 「同意」 2026-11-05T21:57Z), item A and item 3. ⛔ Not a claim.

Ruling-ref: 6670707546

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 币种码回填按组织走：引擎函数加 `organizationId`，CLI 加 `--org`；库里有多个组织而没给 `--org` 就拒跑，并列出各组织的无码行数（可旁显该组织本位币作参考，绝不写入）；`--all-organizations` 显式才一码写全库；单组织库不变。重算命令 `recompute-home-amounts` 同样加 `--org`。
- **为什么改：** 现在一个 `--code` 会写进所有组织的无码行，多组织库上对某些组织是静默写错。
- **风险与回滚：** 小，CLI 行为在多组织库上从「写」变「拒」；单组织库不变。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/objectql` 的 `backfillRecordCurrencyCodes`，`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/record-currency-codes.ts`。
- **两分钟验证：** 两个组织的库：无 `--org` 退出 1 且零写入；`--org A` 只写 A 的行。
- **需要您做的：** 无。

## Task

- [ ] `backfillRecordCurrencyCodes` gains an `organizationId` option; the walk and every `engine.update` run under `{ isSystem: true, tenantId: organizationId }` (the mechanism `engine-driver-read-scope.test.ts` already pins). The report counts per organization.
- [ ] `os migrate record-currency-codes --org <id>`. On a database holding more than one organization, a run without `--org` is refused before any write (exit 1); the refusal lists each organization's codeless row count, and MAY show that organization's current `localization.currency` beside it as a reference only. ⛔ It is never written (ADR-0144 D8 rule 4).
- [ ] `--all-organizations` is the explicit way to write one code into every organization. `--org` and `--all-organizations` together are a usage error.
- [ ] A single-organization database behaves exactly as today (pin it).
- [ ] Ruling item 3: `os migrate recompute-home-amounts` (PR #30183) takes the same `--org` shape, passed to `recomputeHomeAmounts` as an organization filter; without it the run still covers every organization, each in its own home currency (no refusal: recompute writes no caller-chosen value).
- [ ] Keep all logic in the objectql functions; the CLI only parses and prints, so the REST door (the B card) reuses them unchanged.
- [ ] Tests: two organizations on memory, SQLite and Postgres: refusal lists both counts and writes nothing; `--org` writes only that organization; `--all-organizations` writes both; single-org unchanged; `--json` envelope for the refusal. Docs beside the commands in `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`.

Lane: server · Size: S · Model: opus, effort medium · Review: default. `Clause-②: yes (widening: new optional option on two exported objectql functions)` · `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Out of scope: the REST door (B card); `docs/adr/**` and `skills/**` (the seat's Tier H close-out card).

Dedupe: #8345 thread; PR #28128 review 6525881524 S1; no open card carries organization scoping for these commands.
